description.zh: 列出自己维护的仓库里还开着的 issue：一行一条，左边状态点，中间是仓库、编号与标签，右边是最后一次更新的时间，点一行就开对应的页；令牌在卡片设置里填。
description.en: Lists the open issues on the repositories you maintain, one per row: a state dot, the repository, number and labels, and the last update on the right; click a row to open it. The token goes in the card settings.

description.zh: 只读公开仓库的令牌就够了；账号由令牌决定，不用另填用户名。
description.en: A read-only token is enough; the account comes from the token, so there is no username to fill in.

empty.zh: 自己维护的仓库里没有还开着的 issue
empty.en: No open issues on your repositories

unconfigured.zh: 在卡片设置里填入 GitHub 令牌，就能看到自己维护的仓库里还开着的 issue。
unconfigured.en: Add a GitHub token in the card settings to see the open issues on the repositories you maintain.

rejected.zh: GitHub 不认这个令牌：它可能过期、被撤掉了，或者没有读这些仓库的权限。
rejected.en: GitHub rejected the token: it may be expired, revoked, or unable to read these repositories.

more.zh: 最近的 {n} 条 · 共 {total} 条

props.limit.hint.zh: 3 到 30 之间，默认 8 条
